scoreboard.zRule: every line carries a z, inferred where implied (Sailor 2026-10-13); inferred lines are marked zInferred with a zWhy

lines.quote: Russia to send first diesel tanker to the US — Thursday, to an undisclosed port
lines.note: THE DOOR: headline and dek. 'First' concedes that thirteen days after 'immediately' nothing has moved; 'undisclosed' withholds the one fact a delivery is
lines.zWhy: a dated first sailing leans delivers; a withheld port holds it back

lines.quote: Novak told reporters the first diesel tanker bound for the US would sail Thursday, under the deal with Trump
lines.note: the sailing, dated 10-22, by the seller's deputy PM
lines.zWhy: a sailing date is delivery beginning

lines.quote: the vessel carries 40,000 tonnes; Novak did not name the US destination port
lines.note: THE SIZE: 40,000 t against the terms' 300,000 t 'immediately' — 13% of the first tranche. The lowest-Dia line on the paper's deal file; the arithmetic is the cut's, not the wire's
lines.zWhy: a cargo sized at an eighth of the promise delivers a little

lines.quote: Moscow lifted its diesel export ban on 9 October — imposed to address domestic shortages caused by drone attacks
lines.note: the enabling act in Russia's own register, dated to the deal's day: the seller was under an export ban when it sold
lines.zWhy: a ban lifted is the cargo's precondition met

lines.quote: Ukraine's defence ministry: drone strikes disabled at least half of Russia's refining capacity, forcing diesel cuts at its major refineries
lines.note: THE CHALLENGE: the seller's capacity by the striker's count — H2's record (falsified 10-12) returns as H1's constraint. Stationed with the publication, as reported
lines.zWhy: a seller at half capacity under a domestic shortage cannot fill the schedule

lines.quote: Additional shipments will follow, of course
lines.note: the seller's own delivery claim, citing leader-level agreements and 'within its capacity' — constitutive, never Dia-scored

lines.quote: US envoy Steve Witkoff, meeting Putin in St Petersburg, backed Novak's comments
lines.note: the buyer's side present, in person, in the seller's city
lines.zWhy: an envoy in the room is the deal still being made

lines.quote: We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now — needing financing; and fertiliser in large quantities
lines.note: constitutive: the principal's envoy. 'Needing financing' is the clause that un-credits the schedule — a cargo that still needs financing has not been paid for; the settlement layer reads unknown. Fertiliser widens the deal past H1's terms

lines.quote: 300,000 tonnes (2.25 million barrels), then 500,000 tonnes in November, then 1 million tonnes immediately thereafter
lines.note: THE Z-ASSERTION, restated by the wire without the arithmetic: the schedule H1 is tested against. The principal

lines.quote: US drivers still face high pump prices, especially diesel — AAA $6.31 a gallon, down from $6.51 a month earlier — with the midterms under two weeks away
lines.note: THE PRICE AND THE CLOCK: the shadow column ($6.31; MS NOW read $6.32 on 10-15) and the slate's clock in one sentence. The twenty cents fell before any cargo moved
lines.zWhy: relief that arrived before the cargo is not the deal delivering
